SELECT n.notice_id, p.payment_id, p.contract_id, c.customer_id, p.park_id, n.notice_no, CONCAT('ZD', p.payment_id) AS payment_no, c.contract_no, c.customer_name, c.building_name, c.room_name, bc.contact_phone, bc.contact_email, p.fee_name, p.period_start, p.period_end, p.amount_due, p.amount_paid, p.pay_deadline, COALESCE(n.sms_status, 'pending') AS sms_status, COALESCE(n.email_status, 'pending') AS email_status, COALESCE(n.inbox_status, 'pending') AS inbox_status, COALESCE(n.miniapp_status, 'pending') AS miniapp_status, n.miniapp_send_time, COALESCE(n.send_count, 0) AS send_count, n.last_send_time, n.file_name, n.file_url, n.remark, DATE(COALESCE(n.create_time, p.create_time, p.pay_deadline)) AS generated_date, CASE WHEN p.pay_deadline < CURDATE() AND COALESCE(p.pay_status, '0') != '1' THEN 'overdue' ELSE 'payment' END AS notice_category, CASE WHEN n.notice_type IS NULL OR n.notice_type = 'invoice-apply' THEN CASE WHEN p.pay_deadline < CURDATE() AND COALESCE(p.pay_status, '0') != '1' THEN 'overdue-notice' ELSE 'payment-notice' END ELSE n.notice_type END AS notice_type, CASE WHEN COALESCE(n.sms_status, '') = 'success' OR COALESCE(n.email_status, '') = 'success' OR COALESCE(n.inbox_status, '') = 'success' OR COALESCE(n.miniapp_status, '') IN ('success', 'reserved') THEN 'sent' WHEN COALESCE(n.sms_status, '') = 'failed' OR COALESCE(n.email_status, '') = 'failed' OR COALESCE(n.inbox_status, '') = 'failed' OR COALESCE(n.miniapp_status, '') = 'failed' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END AS notice_send_status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.pay_status, '0') = '1' THEN 'paid' WHEN COALESCE(legal_send_stat.legal_send_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'legal' WHEN COALESCE(reminder_stat.reminder_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'reminded' WHEN p.pay_deadline < CURDATE() THEN 'overdue' ELSE 'pending' END AS bill_status, law_cwr.process_status AS overdue_approval_status, COALESCE(legal_send_stat.legal_send_count, 0) AS legal_send_count, legal_send_stat.legal_last_send_time, COALESCE(reminder_stat.reminder_count, 0) AS reminder_count, reminder_stat.latest_reminder_time FROM biz_contract_payment p LEFT JOIN biz_contract c ON c.contract_id = p.contract_id LEFT JOIN biz_customer bc ON bc.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN biz_payment_notice n ON n.payment_id = p.payment_id AND n.del_flag = '0'
AND n.notice_type = #{query.noticeType}
AND n.notice_type = 'reminder-notice'
AND n.notice_type = 'overdue-notice'
AND n.notice_type = 'payment-notice'
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payment_id, MAX(record_id) AS record_id FROM biz_contract_workflow_record WHERE business_type = 'contract_overdue_legal' AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY payment_id ) latest_law_cwr ON latest_law_cwr.payment_id = p.payment_id LEFT JOIN biz_contract_workflow_record law_cwr ON law_cwr.record_id = latest_law_cwr.record_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p2.payment_id, COUNT(l.log_id) AS legal_send_count, MAX(l.operate_time) AS legal_last_send_time FROM biz_contract_payment p2 INNER JOIN biz_contract_log l ON l.contract_id = p2.contract_id AND l.action = 'legal_letter_send' AND l.action_desc LIKE CONCAT('%账单ID：', p2.payment_id, '%') GROUP BY p2.payment_id ) legal_send_stat ON legal_send_stat.payment_id = p.payment_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payment_id, COUNT(1) AS reminder_count, MAX(remind_time) AS latest_reminder_time FROM biz_overdue_reminder_record WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY payment_id ) reminder_stat ON reminder_stat.payment_id = p.payment_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY COALESCE(n.create_time, p.create_time, p.pay_deadline) DESC, p.payment_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_id) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN n.file_url IS NOT NULL AND n.file_url != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS generated_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(n.send_count, 0)), 0) AS send_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(n.sms_status, 'pending') = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sms_success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(n.email_status, 'pending') = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS email_success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(n.inbox_status, 'pending') = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inbox_success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(n.miniapp_status, 'pending') IN ('success', 'reserved') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS miniapp_success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.pay_deadline < CURDATE() AND COALESCE(p.pay_status, '0') != '1' AND ( ( 5 * FLOOR(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2000-01-03') / 7) + LEAST(MOD(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2000-01-03'), 7), 5) - 5 * FLOOR(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(DATE(p.pay_deadline), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2000-01-03') / 7) - LEAST(MOD(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(DATE(p.pay_deadline), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2000-01-03'), 7), 5) ) ) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS five_business_day_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(reminder_stat.reminder_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reminded_bill_count, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(reminder_stat.reminder_count, 0)), 0) AS reminder_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.pay_deadline < CURDATE() AND COALESCE(p.pay_status, '0') != '1' AND ( ( 5 * FLOOR(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2000-01-03') / 7) + LEAST(MOD(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2000-01-03'), 7), 5) - 5 * FLOOR(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(DATE(p.pay_deadline), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2000-01-03') / 7) - LEAST(MOD(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(DATE(p.pay_deadline), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '2000-01-03'), 7), 5) ) ) >= 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS twenty_business_day_count, SUM(CASE WHEN law_cwr.process_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_legal_count FROM biz_contract_payment p LEFT JOIN biz_contract c ON c.contract_id = p.contract_id LEFT JOIN biz_customer bc ON bc.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN biz_payment_notice n ON n.payment_id = p.payment_id AND n.del_flag = '0' AND n.notice_type = CASE WHEN #{query.categoryQuery} = 'reminder' THEN 'reminder-notice' WHEN #{query.categoryQuery} = 'overdue' THEN 'overdue-notice' ELSE 'payment-notice' END LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payment_id, MAX(record_id) AS record_id FROM biz_contract_workflow_record WHERE business_type = 'contract_overdue_legal' AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY payment_id ) latest_law_cwr ON latest_law_cwr.payment_id = p.payment_id LEFT JOIN biz_contract_workflow_record law_cwr ON law_cwr.record_id = latest_law_cwr.record_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p2.payment_id, COUNT(l.log_id) AS legal_send_count, MAX(l.operate_time) AS legal_last_send_time FROM biz_contract_payment p2 INNER JOIN biz_contract_log l ON l.contract_id = p2.contract_id AND l.action = 'legal_letter_send' AND l.action_desc LIKE CONCAT('%账单ID：', p2.payment_id, '%') GROUP BY p2.payment_id ) legal_send_stat ON legal_send_stat.payment_id = p.payment_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payment_id, COUNT(1) AS reminder_count, MAX(remind_time) AS latest_reminder_time FROM biz_overdue_reminder_record WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY payment_id ) reminder_stat ON reminder_stat.payment_id = p.payment_id

SELECT notice_id, payment_id, notice_no, notice_type, sms_status, email_status, inbox_status, send_count, last_send_time, file_name, file_url, miniapp_status, miniapp_send_time, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM biz_payment_notice WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND del_flag = '0' AND notice_type = #{noticeType} ORDER BY notice_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.building_name FROM biz_contract_payment p LEFT JOIN biz_contract c ON c.contract_id = p.contract_id LEFT JOIN biz_payment_notice n ON n.payment_id = p.payment_id AND n.del_flag = '0' AND n.notice_type = CASE WHEN #{query.categoryQuery} = 'reminder' THEN 'reminder-notice' WHEN #{query.categoryQuery} = 'overdue' THEN 'overdue-notice' ELSE 'payment-notice' END
c.building_name IS NOT NULL AND c.building_name != ''
ORDER BY c.building_name ASC
